map.LTV客户终身价值计算器 使用指南: LTV customer lifetime value calculator guide
map.简单模式按客单价、年购买频次、客户生命周期和毛利率估算 LTV；详细模式改用月均: Simple mode estimates LTV from order value, annual purchase frequency, customer lifetime and gross margin; detailed mode switches to average monthly revenue, monthly churn and acquisition cost CAC, and gives the LTV:CAC ratio to judge whether acquisition spend pays off.
map.简单模式用客单价×频次×生命周期×毛利率。: Simple mode uses order value x frequency x lifetime x gross margin.
map.详细模式用（月收入×毛利率）/月流失率。: Detailed mode uses (monthly revenue x gross margin) / monthly churn.
map.算 LTV 后配 CAC 做获客决策。: Compute LTV and pair it with CAC for acquisition decisions.
map.：客单价 100、年购 12 次、生命周期 3 年、毛利率 30% → LTV=: : order value 100, 12 purchases a year, lifetime 3 years, gross margin 30% -> LTV = 100 x 12 x 3 x 30% = 1080 CNY.
map.：月收入 MRR=50、毛利率 30%、月流失率 10% → 生命周期=1/10: : monthly revenue MRR = 50, gross margin 30%, monthly churn 10% -> lifetime = 1/10% = 10 months, LTV = (50 x 30%)/10% = 150 CNY (monthly revenue basis).
map.两种模式结果差很多？: Do the two modes give very different results?
map.口径不同：简单按年购频次、详细按留存衰减，订阅制用详细模式更准。: The basis differs: the simple model uses annual purchase frequency, the detailed one uses retention decay, and the subscription model is more accurate for subscription businesses.
map.LTV 要扣成本吗？: Should costs be deducted from LTV?
map.应用毛利率折算成毛利 LTV，否则高估回报；本工具默认用毛利率。: Convert to gross-profit LTV using the gross margin, otherwise the return is overstated; this tool applies gross margin by default.
